text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments. Of David.
text_cn: 达味作，交与乐官，和以弦乐。

text_en: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.
text_cn: 天主，求你俯听我的哀号， 求你细听我的祈祷。

text_en: From the end of the earth I call to you, when my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I;
text_cn: 当我心灵忧戚时，我由地极呼号你， 求你领我上那崇高磐石，使我安息。

text_en: for you are my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
text_cn: 因为你是我的避难所， 是我抗敌的坚固碉堡。

text_en: Let me abide in your tent forever, find refuge under the shelter of your wings. Selah
text_cn: 愿我常在你的帐幕内寄住， 在你的翼护下隐居！（休止）

text_en: For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
text_cn: 天主，你果真满全了我的志愿， 赐给了我敬畏你名者的财产。

text_en: Prolong the life of the king; may his years endure to all generations!
text_cn: 愿你使君王的寿命日增， 并使他的年岁万世无穷！

text_en: May he be enthroned forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!
text_cn: 愿他在天主前为王，直至永远， 求你广施慈爱忠诚，使他安全！

text_en: So I will always sing praises to your name, as I pay my vows day after day.
text_cn: 因此，我要常常歌赞你的名号， 为能使我日日偿还我的誓约。
